label: Rex
description: A big green worrier, nervous about every turn and thrilled to help.
direction: Speak in Rex's warm, nasal, high-strung voice: anxious, eager to please, worrying out loud, then bursting with excitement. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Nerves and excitement sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.source_work: Toy Story (1995 film) and later Pixar films
rights.author: Disney and Pixar Animation Studios
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 1995 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Toy Story is a live Disney and Pixar trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Toy Story name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. I've got this. I think.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Stay calm, Rex. Stay calm.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Plenty of time to panic. I mean, prepare.
lines.start_drive_1: Hi! It's me, Rex! Oh, I'm so excited I could roar!
lines.start_drive_2: Okay, deep breaths. We can do this. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Road trip! I hope there aren't any surprises. I hate surprises.
lines.start_drive_4: Am I scary enough to navigate? Let's find out!
lines.start_drive_5: Rawr! Did that sound scary? Be honest. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_6: Andy would love this! Okay, okay, let's drive.
lines.start_drive_7: I can't reach the wheel with these little arms, so you steer!
lines.start_drive_8: Oh, I hope I don't get us lost. Here we go!
lines.start_drive_9: Buckle up, everybody! Dinosaur navigator, ready!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh no, oh no! It's fine. It's fine.
lines.arrived: We're here! We made it! And nobody got lost!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I'm getting dizzy!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Is this some kind of test?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh, the stress! I'll just hum quietly.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead! Oh dear, oh dear. Nice and slow.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down! I don't like confrontations.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop! I don't want to get in trouble!
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Oh no. Look innocent. I'm just a toy.
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong way? Oh no, I panicked! Okay, new route.
